title: Forward morphisms extending a bounded-flat normalization
statement: Let f : Z → Y be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], with derived categories in a common universe [def-pc-derived-category], F the recorded derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] supplied with a strong monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and additive termwise tensor pullback H [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write q for the homotopy quotient, Q_Y,Q_Z for the derived localizations, L=Q_Y⋙F, G=H^h⋙Q_Z. Let B be boundedFlatShiftRepresentative [def-sc-bounded-flat-shift-representative], T be flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative and let stage maps mean flatTelescopeStageMap [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map]. For a fixed e : F(𝟙_Y[1]) ≅ 𝟙_Z[1], set b_e(K)=F(c_Y(K)⁻¹);δ_F(𝟙_Y[1],K);(e⊗id);c_Z(FK), where c is the canonical translated-unit comparison [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. Suppose supplied isomorphisms β_X:LX≅GX for X in B are natural for all homotopy morphisms between B objects, and satisfy β_{qP[1]};commShift_G(qP)=F(commShift_Q_Y(qP));b_e(Q_YqP);β_{qP}[1] for every bounded-above termwise-flat P [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Then there exist morphisms a_X:LX→GX for X in T, natural for stage maps, with a_X=β_X.hom for every X in T∩B, and satisfying a_{qP[1]};commShift_G(qP)=F(commShift_Q_Y(qP));b_e(Q_YqP);a_{qP}[1] for every literal flat telescope P. No invertibility of a_X is asserted.

source.place: Forward-map construction part of steps 1--3 of lem-sc-flat-telescope-bounded-normalization-extension; inherited agent expansion of the telescope model argument.

proof.text: Use the proved complex-coproduct lemma to construct the two sum comparison morphisms as the unique coproduct descents of the bounded β components. Their coprojection formulas are the universal property. On a Sigma.map, precompose with each coprojection and use bounded naturality; coproduct uniqueness proves sum naturality. Prove naturality of the translated-unit composite from the tensorator, first-variable Koszul shift and left unitor. On each shifted coprojection, substitute the supplied bounded shift equation and the unshifted coprojection formula; shifted coproduct uniqueness proves the sum shift equation.
Apply the cone extension and descent theorem to the constructed sum maps and all five proved compatibility equations. This preserves the supplied beta, e, and the full original conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Coproduct construction and shift/naturality equations proved in Lean; cone descent isolated as one remaining theorem.

theorem exists_flat_telescope_normalization_morphisms
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).Additive]
    (e : (derivedPullback f).obj ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
        (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Z))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (β : ∀ X : HomotopyCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
        boundedFlatShiftRepresentative Y X →
          ((DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).obj X ≅
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
              (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
                schemeDerivedCategory Z)).obj X))
    (hβnat : (∀ (X X' : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
          (hX : boundedFlatShiftRepresentative Y X) (hX' : boundedFlatShiftRepresentative Y X')
          (s : X ⟶ X'),
          (DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).map s ≫ (β X' hX').hom =
            (β X hX).hom ≫
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
                (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
                  (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
                  schemeDerivedCategory Z)).map s))
    (hβshift : ∀ (P : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hb : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero (P.X i))
        (hf : ∀ i : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlat (P.X i)),
        let X := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P
        let G := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
            schemeDerivedCategory Z)
        (β (X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ⟨P, hb, hf, Or.inr rfl⟩).hom ≫
            (G.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app X =
          (derivedPullback f).map ((DerivedCategory.Qh.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app X) ≫
            ((derivedPullback f).mapIso
                (schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Y (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X)).symm ≪≫
              asIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (derivedPullback f)
                ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X)) ≪≫
              tensorIso e (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
              schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Z
                ((derivedPullback f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X))).hom ≫
            (β X ⟨P, hb, hf, Or.inl rfl⟩).hom⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') :
      ∃ α : ∀ X : HomotopyCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
        flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X →
          ((DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).obj X ⟶
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
              (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
                schemeDerivedCategory Z)).obj X),
        (∀ (X X' : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
          (hX : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X) (hX' : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X')
          (s : X ⟶ X'), flatTelescopeStageMap Y s →
          (DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).map s ≫ (α X' hX') =
            (α X hX) ≫
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
                (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
                  (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
                  schemeDerivedCategory Z)).map s) ∧
        (∀ (X : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
          (hX : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X)
          (hb : boundedFlatShiftRepresentative Y X), α X hX = (β X hb).hom) ∧
        ∀ (P : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (htel : isFlatTelescope Y P),
        let X := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P
        let G := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
            schemeDerivedCategory Z)
        (α (X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ⟨P, htel, Or.inr rfl⟩) ≫
            (G.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app X =
          (derivedPullback f).map ((DerivedCategory.Qh.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app X) ≫
            ((derivedPullback f).mapIso
                (schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Y (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X)).symm ≪≫
              asIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (derivedPullback f)
                ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X)) ≪≫
              tensorIso e (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
              schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Z
                ((derivedPullback f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X))).hom ≫
            (α X ⟨P, htel, Or.inl rfl⟩)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
